_notes: Set actor_id to the Apify Instagram Reels scraper you choose, then fit input_template to that actor's input schema (see its Input tab).

Two candidates seen in a web search, neither tested here: api-empire/instagram-reels-scraper (hashtag and keyword search) and sones/instagram-reels-scraper-lowcost (adds transcripts). Check price and recent reviews first.
Placeholders {hashtags} and {terms} are filled from config/keywords.txt (lines starting with # are hashtags).
The real spending guard is the monthly usage limit on your Apify account. Set one before the first live run.
On the first live run, open out/<week>/raw_sample.json and check the field names; add any that differ under field_map.
profile_actor_id: an Apify actor that returns recent Reels for given usernames (it can be the same actor if it supports profiles). Used only when config/creators.txt has accounts.
Placeholder {usernames} in profile_input_template is filled from config/creators.txt.

per_keyword_runs: true runs the actor once per keyword so every Reel is tagged with the keyword that found it (needed to spread the library across keywords). Set resultsLimit in input_template to the number of Reels you want PER keyword.
For the transcript and the video hook the actor should return a direct video URL (videoUrl) and, if it can, a transcript; otherwise transcripts are made from the video with ffmpeg + faster-whisper.
